title: Molecular Stratification of Renal Cancer Reveals Prognostic Biomarkers and Therapeutic Pathways

contributions.purpose: 用生存导向特征选择得精简预后基因签名
contributions.mechanism: 从 1000 高变基因迭代优化到 76 基因,K-means 聚成两亚型(TCGA 314 例 KIRC mRNA)
contributions.evaluation: 26 轮迭代把 log-rank p 改善 3.1 倍;两亚型 log-rank p=4.51e-4,χ2=12.31
contributions.domain: 肿瘤转录组/生物标志物发现
contributions.source_quote: we refined 1,000 highly variable genes into a compact 76-gene signature that enabled unsupervised clustering into two prognostically distinct subgroups

contributions.purpose: 刻画两个预后不同的分子亚型
contributions.mechanism: 比较亚型生存与事件率、中位生存
contributions.source_quote: Patients in the high-risk subgroup exhibited significantly poorer overall survival (log-rank p =4.5×10−4) and elevated event rates

contributions.purpose: 揭示亚型特异生物标志物与通路
contributions.mechanism: 差异表达+单变量 Cox+KEGG/GO 富集
contributions.evaluation: 2,927 差异基因,70% 单变量 Cox 显著;NUTF2 HR=1.53(p=1.10e-5);富集 TOR 信号/自噬/负调控分解代谢
contributions.source_quote: Differential expression analysis revealed 2,927 subtype-specific genes, of which 70% demonstrated significant associations with survival in univariate Cox regression.

notes: 方法学红旗(循环自证/double-dipping):特征选择被显式迭代优化以"maximize survival outcome separation between molecular subtypes",再把同一分离的 log-rank p(及"3.1-fold improvement")当作发现报告——选择偏倚/数据泄漏,p 值按构造必然显著;70% 差异基因"与生存相关"同受此偏倚影响。无独立验证队列,仅单一 TCGA 数据集(checklist 亦提示结果"only tested on a few datasets")。除此之外为可信 TCGA 生信流程。checklist AI 自披露:实验设计/分析 [D](AI 95%,含写代码与解释),假设/写作 [C]。type=finding/resource。
